integrity: Exact symbolic proof covers all positive compositions; checker performs supplementary exact finite rational enumeration. This mathematical analysis does not establish field measurements, calibrated assay performance, or independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Independent categorical-read idealization; no amplification, extraction, cost, contamination, false-detection, or heterogeneous library effects. Comparison is equal two-site split versus equal mixture at four reads and does not establish empirical pooling superiority; optimized split dominates pooling. Historical priority beyond inspected sources is provisional.
title: A three-species pooled-read reversal under equal-site biodiversity sampling
